result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to cut-off cards at the screen edge and inconsistent content clarity in category filters and promotional labels.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indicator or partial card is clearly clipped intentionally, or adjust card width so text is not abruptly truncated mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off at the right edge, showing a partial pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Add fade-out gradient or ensure the scrollable row clearly indicates more content is available.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the pizza promotion at the bottom is ambiguous and could be confused with a discount error (100% off suggests free item, which may be misleading).
issues.suggestion: Clarify the promotion text, e.g., 'Free item' or specify the actual discount context.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white outline on a busy food image, making it slightly hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle circular background behind the icon for better contrast and visibility.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the very bottom is cropped by the navigation bar, cutting off potential text/details below the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding or scroll space so promotional cards are not obscured by the bottom navigation bar.
